explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 62 named tracks, releases and catalogue cuts across current September 10–12 electronic pages, TraTraTrax's newly issued Los Totes Vol. 3 sampler, Meakusma's emerging 666ridims field, adjacent Colombian/Caribbean club-music label pages, and overlooked raw polyrhythmic and experimental-techno catalogue links. Official and attributed written evidence only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 182's Maxime Denuc and D1 field and Runs 170–181 were not recycled; canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits and exact utility-ledger identities were excluded.

Five Los Totes Vol. 3 identities survived because current exact-track criticism distinguishes their rhythmic or structural propositions. Four 666ridims identities survive at a weaker collection-level evidence class because Meakusma explicitly frames the set around odd metres, polyrhythm, swing transformation and speculative club forms.

Other current pages and catalogue items were excluded when they offered only artist prestige, generic genre tags, ambiguous track naming, a prior persistent-state identity or no credible lawful placement hypothesis.

All proposed placement pairs were re-derived from the current 50-track ledger and checked for adjacency and prose agreement. No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
